fields.CLAIM: The promoted E004 operator-valued rung500 checkpoint exposes task-relevant negation information at operator-valued sites beyond seed-matched standard-attention controls, matched random-site nulls when feasible, shuffled-label nulls, and decoy contrasts.
fields.CONTROL_THAT_RULES_IT_OUT: Seed-matched standard_refactor_control_30m_seed2_rung500 probes, shuffled-label nulls, matched-dimensional random-site nulls, grouped template splits, x_decoy controls, and explicit feasibility caps for operator_probs when no compatible null/control site exists.
fields.FDR_SCOPE: Every computed site x layer x task_family x metric cell in the run, including linear_probe_auc_minus_0_5, auc_minus_shuffled_auc, auc_minus_random_site_auc when available, auc_minus_matched_control_auc when available, target_vs_decoy_specificity, component_patch_restoration, full_layer_patch_restoration, and mediation_fraction when valid; not only the pre-registered target site and not only the primary metric.
fields.FEATURE_POOLING_RULE: Confirmatory candidate_mechanism_evidence requires task-aligned feature pooling (`patch_positions_mean` by default, or `answer_position`). Mean-sequence pooling is allowed only as exploratory/diagnostic evidence and caps the top claim.
KILL_CONDITION: Any target site lacks real trained probe metrics under grouped template-level splitting.
Any confirmatory family has fewer than 50 contrast pairs or lacks deterministic provenance.
Decoy specificity fails after bootstrap confidence intervals and FDR-BH correction.
The canonical seed2 matched control is unavailable, overridden noncanonically, or seed-mismatched.
A random-site null is unavailable or not beaten for any site x layer x family cell claiming controlled evidence.
The low-dimensional operator_probs cell is interpreted as full-width d_model evidence or coerced into an activation null.
Feature pooling is not task-aligned to answer or patch positions in a confirmatory full run.
Restoration patching lacks valid clean/corrupt token alignment metadata.
Restoration or mediation metrics are unavailable, invalid, or have invalid denominators.
Results only support controlled_probe_signal when causal restoration/mediation fails but probe/null/control gates pass.
fields.MATCHED_CONTROL_RULE: The canonical seed2 standard-refactor rung500 control must be used for candidate_mechanism_evidence. Noncanonical overrides may be recorded for exploratory analysis but cap claims below candidate_mechanism_evidence.
fields.MECHANISM_PROOF: Candidate evidence requires grouped linear-probe AUC above chance, above shuffled labels, above a matched-dimensional random site where one exists, and above the canonical seed2 standard control for comparable full-width operator output sites, all under bootstrap confidence intervals and FDR-BH correction, plus target-vs-decoy specificity and valid component/full-layer restoration with a valid mediation_fraction.
fields.NEAREST_BORING_EXPLANATION: Operator-valued sites may only reflect lexical frequency, prompt surface form, broad topic/adverb artifacts, ordinary standard-attention output features, or a low-dimensional routing probability that is not comparable to full-width activation sites.
fields.RANDOM_SITE_NULL_RULE: Each site x layer cell needs a non-candidate site with matched feature dimensionality and compatible tensor kind. operator_probs may lack such a null because it is low-dimensional probability output, while full-width operator output sites may use matched full-width activation sites when available.
fields.RESTORATION_AND_MEDIATION_REQUIREMENTS: component_patch_restoration, full_layer_patch_restoration, and mediation_fraction must be valid and must pass FDR-BH correction. Task records must provide single-token GPT-2 target/foil metadata, valid clean/corrupt answer positions, and explicit patch token alignment when clean and corrupted prompts have different token lengths. Invalid restoration or mediation denominators force controlled_probe_signal or insufficient_evidence, not candidate_mechanism_evidence.
fields.SPECIFICITY_GATE: The bootstrap confidence interval for target_vs_decoy_specificity must exclude zero in the expected positive direction after FDR-BH correction.
fields.STATISTICAL_TEST: Grouped train/test split by template_id, bootstrap confidence intervals over grouped pairs, and FDR-BH over every computed site x layer x task_family x metric cell.

TARGET_SITES.feasibility_note: Low-dimensional operator probability vectors must not be coerced into d_model activation comparisons. This cell can provide exploratory/probe signal but cannot claim controlled evidence when matched random-site/control comparisons are unavailable.

TASK_CONTRASTS.x_para: negation preserved under marker variation using never
TASK_CONTRASTS.x_pos: explicit negation with a not-style marker
